finalists.label: Toxoplasmosis
finalists.why: Strong evidence from serum toxoplasma IgG, CSF studies, and histopathologic examination of the brain tissue.

finalists.label: Bacterial pneumonia
finalists.why: Productive cough and new left upper lobe opacification with diffuse reticulonodular interstitial prominence are specific to this candidate.

finalists.label: Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia
finalists.why: HIV infection with a CD4 count <20 cells/µL and chest radiograph findings are specific to this candidate.

frontier_selector.why: The combination of HIV infection with a CD4 count <20 cells/µL, fever, and chest radiograph findings decided the final comparison in favor of Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia.

support_spans: CSF studies showed 48 cells/µL (97% lymphocytes) with positive toxoplasma IgG and DNA-PCR for Toxoplasma gondii (286 copies/mL)
Histopathologic examination of the brain tissue revealed bradyzoites and tachyzoites

Chest radiograph showed a new left upper lobe opacification with diffuse reticulonodular interstitial prominence
CT scan of the chest confirmed extensive reticulonodular interstitial infiltrates with focal consolidation in the left upper lobe
